##### Project general facts

Reportage Towers by Reportage Properties is a modern mixed-use development featuring two elegant residential towers connected to a vibrant retail and shopping area. The project offers 1,086 residences, including studios, 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments, along with commercial and retail spaces within the podium.

Residents can enjoy an impressive range of amenities, including a large swimming pool, kids’ pool, gym, jogging track, yoga area, multipurpose court, outdoor cinema, BBQ areas and landscaped gardens. The development also provides kids’ playgrounds, shaded seating areas, coffee lounges, private parking for each unit and a shopping mall inside the building.

The apartments are designed with modern and practical interiors, featuring fitted kitchens with cabinets and countertops, built-in wardrobes, fully tiled bathrooms, vanity units and mirrors. Double-glazed windows, central air conditioning, high-speed fibre-optic connections and private balconies or terraces in selected units add extra comfort and quality to everyday living.

##### Location description and benefits

Addis Ababa is the vibrant capital of Ethiopia, offering residents a dynamic urban environment with a welcoming atmosphere and a rich blend of modern and traditional influences. The city is known for its growing infrastructure, diverse neighborhoods, and wide range of everyday conveniences.

Residents can enjoy a variety of restaurants, cafés, shopping destinations, cultural attractions, and recreational spaces throughout the city. Green areas and pleasant highland surroundings add to the appeal, creating opportunities for relaxation while maintaining convenient access to urban amenities.

Addis Ababa also serves as Ethiopia’s major business, diplomatic, and cultural center, providing a lively environment with plenty of opportunities for work and social activities. Its distinctive character, active lifestyle, and evolving cityscape make it an attractive place for those seeking comfortable urban living in a unique African capital.
